entities.purpose: Maintained knowledge and planning markdown used by agents and review. summary.md is a backend-derived archive from ChapterFile inputs plus import metadata and human edits; new backend-generated summary.md output is deterministically rendered from validated structured batch data rather than model-authored Markdown; post-confirm archive maintenance refreshes summary.md from accepted ChapterFile artifacts before projecting status_card.md from the fresh summary; the world_model/status_card/domain_rules trio acts as the creative constraint engine for webnovel production and carries constraint lifecycle/applicability semantics; the outline quartet acts as the serial control layer with SOURCE_FACT, AUTHOR_PROPOSAL, and WORLD_MODEL_REQUIRED evidence modes; chapter_draft.md is the continuation production artifact and review surface before accepted sections are canonized into ChapterFile artifacts. New backend world/status initialization renders world_model.md and status_card.md from schema-locked world facts rather than trusting model-authored Markdown.
state_fields: constraint lifecycle: current-active, historical-only, retired, overridden, disabled, conditional, inherited-residue, unresolved
constraint applicability scope: global, timeline, arc, stage, loop, faction, POV, location, rule system, evidence window
outline role for brainstorm/master/arc/chapter outline files
outline evidence mode: SOURCE_FACT, AUTHOR_PROPOSAL, WORLD_MODEL_REQUIRED
world fact category, subject, lifecycle, applicability scope, evidence, confidence, and downstream impact
status projection evidence anchors and ??? ratio
entities.migration_notes: Adding/removing tracked layout files requires amendment and compatibility notes. Existing summary.md files remain valid regardless of whether they were produced by historical Dify reading archive runs or backend pipelines; future first-create/rebuild of summary.md is owned by the backend summary archive pipeline and new output should be rendered from validated structured batch data. Existing world/status/domain files need no automatic migration when creative role or constraint lifecycle semantics change; legacy unscoped constraints remain readable until a future world-model revision or migration classifies them. Existing outline files need no automatic migration when outline control semantics or evidence-mode semantics change. Existing books without chapter_draft.md remain valid until continuation materializes it. Existing chapter_draft.md files are not automatically backfilled into chapters/*.md; accepted continuation prose becomes ChapterFile content only through confirm-time canonization or a future explicit repair action. Post-confirm archive bridge refreshes are forward-only derived updates and do not require backfilling older confirmations. First-create/rebuild of world_model.md and status_card.md is owned by the backend batch pipeline. New structured world facts are intermediate derived validation inputs for rebuilds, not a persisted source file; existing world/status files remain valid until explicit rebuild.
requires_amendment_when: Changing which agent can write a file
Changing summary.md source/derived ownership, output format, metadata boundary, or rebuild semantics
Changing post-confirm archive bridge ownership, ordering, or freshness semantics
Changing creative constraint roles of world/status/domain files
Changing constraint lifecycle values, applicability scopes, or current-active consumption semantics
Changing outline quartet control roles, evidence-mode semantics, or write ownership
Changing continuation chapter_draft.md production ownership or length-gate semantics
Changing initialization source for world_model.md or status_card.md
Changing status projection evidence or ??? acceptance semantics

Outline route writes are limited to brainstorm.md, master_outline.md, arc_outline.md, and chapter_outline.md. Continuation route writes are limited to chapter_draft.md. reading_archive_agent is retired from active summary.md generation and should be removed from default route activation in the implementation slice.

Changing continuation production ownership or allowed continuation targets
Re-enabling reading_archive_agent as active summary.md owner

entities.purpose: Live Dify app workflow graph and exported DSL evidence. World model workflow definitions own post-initialization interactive prompt semantics that turn source evidence into creative constraints. Outline workflow definitions own outline initialization/rebuild and production-control prompt semantics for the serial control layer. Continuation workflow definitions own chapter-card execution, chapter_draft.md prose production, and metric-delta repair prompt semantics. Legacy reading archive workflow definitions are historical/compatibility evidence only.
entities.migration_notes: Live DB and local DSL can diverge; contracts must state which one they modify. Summary archive ownership now belongs to the backend summary archive pipeline; Dify reading archive ownership changes require amendment. World initialization ownership now belongs to the backend batch pipeline, so Dify INIT ownership changes require amendment. Outline initialization/rebuild and production-control prompt changes must be proven from live Dify DB when live behavior is changed. Continuation production prompt/tool changes must be proven from live Dify DB and ToolProvider rows.
requires_amendment_when: Changing node strategy or required plugins

Changing world-model constraint lifecycle or applicability-scope prompt semantics
Changing outline layer prompt semantics, evidence-mode semantics, or write ownership
Changing continuation chapter-card execution, length-gate semantics, style metric-delta repair semantics, or write ownership
Re-enabling Dify reading archive ownership for summary.md

entities.purpose: Derived evidence for a rolling chapter-production cycle and continuation workbench projection: cursor state, requested batch size, next action, Dify workflow runs, validation outputs, style advisory summaries, style metric deltas, chapter context packs, Git commits, review packets, review recommendations, human unlock artifacts, and human-review stop state.
entities.migration_notes: No migration or backfill is required. Existing books derive accepted cursor state from current chapters/*.md, pending-review draft state from chapter_draft.md, and continuation workbench projection from current chapter_outline.md plus review state. Existing rolling evidence without review packets remains valid historical evidence but cannot unlock a current hard blocked action without a fresh explicit human unlock artifact. Existing evidence without style_advisory_summary, style_metric_delta, chapter_context_pack, or constraint_lifecycle_refs remains valid history but future repair loops should generate fresh derived evidence from available diagnostics and truth sources.
requires_amendment_when: Changing style advisory or style metric-delta evidence semantics
Changing chapter context pack derived-evidence semantics
Changing constraint lifecycle reference semantics inside rolling evidence
Promoting rolling state to source data
